en.nethack.quest.arc.assignquest.synopsis: [{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} has stolen {quest_quest_artifact}.  Locate {quest_intermediate_destination}, defeat {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}, and return {quest_short_quest_artifact}.]
en.nethack.quest.arc.assignquest.text:
"Grave times have befallen the college, for {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_a} has
stolen {quest_quest_artifact}.  Without it, the board of directors of
the university will soon have no choice but to revoke our research grants.

"You must locate the entrance to {quest_intermediate_destination}.  Within it,
you will find {quest_quest_nemesis}.

"You must then defeat {quest_quest_nemesis} and return {quest_quest_artifact}
to me.

"Only in this way will we be able to prevent the budget cuts that could
close this college.

"May the wisdom of {quest_original_alignment_deity} be your guide."
en.nethack.quest.arc.badalign.synopsis: ["{quest_player_name_modifier_C}, you have strayed from the {quest_original_alignment} path.  Purify yourself!"]
en.nethack.quest.arc.badalign.text:
"{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  I've heard that you've been using sloppy techniques.  Your
results lately can hardly be called suitable for {quest_current_rank_modifier_a}!

"How could you have strayed from the {quest_original_alignment} path?  Go from here, and come
back only when you have purified yourself."
en.nethack.quest.arc.badlevel.text:
"{quest_player_name}, you are yet too inexperienced to undertake such a demanding
quest.  A mere {quest_current_rank} could not possibly face the rigors demanded and
survive.  Go forth, and come here again when your adventures have further
taught you."
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_1: "Try your best, {quest_player_name}.  You cannot defeat me."
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_10: "Die {quest_role_name}!  I shall exhibit your carcass as a trophy."
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_2: "I shall rend the flesh from your body whilst you still breathe!"
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_3: "First you, {quest_player_name}, then I shall destroy your mentor, {quest_quest_leader}."
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_4: "Tiring yet, {quest_player_name}?  I draw my power from my master and cannot falter!"
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_5: "I shall rend thy soul from thy body and consume it!"
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_6: "You are far too {quest_original_alignment} -- it weakens you.  You shall die in this place."
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_7: "{quest_original_alignment_deity} has forsaken you!  You are lost now!"
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_8: "A mere {quest_current_rank} cannot hope to defeat me!"
en.nethack.quest.arc.discourage.item_9: "If you are the best {quest_quest_leader} can send, I have nothing to fear."
en.nethack.quest.arc.encourage.item_10: "You may be able to sense {quest_quest_artifact} when you are near."
en.nethack.quest.arc.encourage.item_2: "To locate the entrance to {quest_intermediate_destination}, you must pass many traps."
en.nethack.quest.arc.encourage.item_3: "A {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_t} may be vulnerable to attacks by magical cold."
en.nethack.quest.arc.encourage.item_5: "You must destroy {quest_quest_nemesis}.  It will pursue you otherwise."
en.nethack.quest.arc.encourage.item_6: "{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} is a mighty talisman.  With it you can destroy {quest_quest_nemesis}."
en.nethack.quest.arc.encourage.item_8: "I will have my {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P} watch for your return."
en.nethack.quest.arc.encourage.item_9: "Remember not to stray from the true {quest_original_alignment} path."
en.nethack.quest.arc.firsttime.synopsis: [You arrive at {quest_quest_home}, but all is not well.]
en.nethack.quest.arc.firsttime.text:
You are suddenly in familiar surroundings.  The buildings in the distance
seem to be those of your old alma mater, but something is wrong.  It feels
as if there has been a riot recently, or {quest_quest_home} has
been under siege.

All of the windows are boarded up, and there are objects scattered around
the entrance.

Strange forbidding shapes seem to be moving in the distance.
en.nethack.quest.arc.goal_first.synopsis: [This strange feeling must be the presence of {quest_quest_artifact}.]
en.nethack.quest.arc.goal_first.text:
A strange feeling washes over you, and you think back to things you
learned during the many lectures of {quest_quest_leader}.

You realize the feeling must be the presence of {quest_quest_artifact}.
en.nethack.quest.arc.goal_next.text: The familiar presence of {quest_quest_artifact} is in the ether.
en.nethack.quest.arc.gotit.synopsis: [The power of {quest_quest_artifact} flows through your body!  You must return it to {quest_quest_leader}.]
en.nethack.quest.arc.gotit.text:
The power of {quest_quest_artifact} flows through your body!  You feel
as if you could now take on the Wizard of Yendor himself and win, but
you know you must return {quest_quest_artifact} to {quest_quest_leader}.
en.nethack.quest.arc.guardtalk_after.item_1: "Did you see Lash LaRue in 'Song of Old Wyoming' the other night?"
en.nethack.quest.arc.guardtalk_after.item_2: "Hey man, got any potions of hallucination for sale?"
en.nethack.quest.arc.guardtalk_after.item_3: "I guess you are guaranteed to make full professor now."
en.nethack.quest.arc.guardtalk_after.item_4: "So, what was worse, {quest_quest_nemesis} or your entrance exams?"
en.nethack.quest.arc.guardtalk_after.item_5: "{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} is impressive, but nothing like the bones I dug up!"
en.nethack.quest.arc.guardtalk_before.item_: "Did you see Lash LaRue in 'Song of Old Wyoming' the other night?"
"Hey man, got any potions of hallucination for sale?"
"Did you see the artifact {quest_quest_leader} brought back from the last dig?"
"So what species do *you* think we evolved from?"
"So you're {quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} prize pupil!  I don't know what he sees in you."
en.nethack.quest.arc.hasamulet.synopsis: [Take the Amulet to the Astral Plane and sacrifice it at the altar of {quest_original_alignment_deity}.]
en.nethack.quest.arc.hasamulet.text:
"Congratulations, {quest_player_name}.  I wondered if anyone could prevail against
the Wizard and the minions of Moloch.  Now, you must embark on one
final adventure.

"Take the Amulet, and find your way onto the Astral Plane.
There you must find the altar of {quest_original_alignment_deity} and sacrifice the
Amulet on that altar to fulfill your destiny.

"Remember, your path now should always be upwards."
en.nethack.quest.arc.killed_nemesis.text: The body of {quest_quest_nemesis} dissipates in a cloud of noxious fumes.
en.nethack.quest.arc.leader_first.synopsis: ["You have returned, {quest_player_name}, to a difficult task."]
en.nethack.quest.arc.leader_first.text:
"Finally you have returned, {quest_player_name}.  You were always
my most promising student.  Allow me to see if you are ready for the
most difficult task of your career."
en.nethack.quest.arc.leader_last.text:
"{quest_player_name}, you have failed us.  All of my careful training has been in
vain.  Begone!  Your tenure at this college has been revoked!

"You are a disgrace to the profession!"
en.nethack.quest.arc.leader_next.text:
"Again, {quest_player_name}, you stand before me.
Let me see if you have gained experience in the interim."
en.nethack.quest.arc.leader_other.text:
"Once more, {quest_player_name}, you have returned from the field.
Are you finally ready for the task that must be accomplished?"
en.nethack.quest.arc.locate_first.synopsis: [This foreboding edifice must hide the entrance to {quest_intermediate_destination}.]
en.nethack.quest.arc.locate_first.text:
A plain opens before you.  Beyond the plain lies a foreboding edifice.

You have the feeling that you will soon find the entrance to
{quest_intermediate_destination}.
en.nethack.quest.arc.locate_next.text: Once again, you are near the entrance to {quest_intermediate_destination}.
en.nethack.quest.arc.nemesis_first.text:
"So, {quest_player_name}, you think that you can succeed in recovering
{quest_quest_artifact}, when your teacher, {quest_quest_leader}, has already failed.

"Come, try your best!  I shall destroy you, and gnaw on your bones."
en.nethack.quest.arc.nemesis_next.synopsis: ["Again you try to best me, {quest_player_name}?  You shall never recover {quest_quest_artifact}."]
en.nethack.quest.arc.nemesis_next.text:
"Again you try to best me, eh {quest_player_name}?  Well, you shall fail again.

"You shall never recover {quest_quest_artifact}.

"I shall bear your soul to the Plane of Origins for my master's pleasure."
en.nethack.quest.arc.nemesis_other.text: "You persist yet {quest_player_name}!  Good.  Now, you shall die!"
en.nethack.quest.arc.nemesis_wantsit.text:
"I shall have {quest_quest_artifact} from you, {quest_player_name}, then feast
upon your entrails!"
en.nethack.quest.arc.nexttime.text: Once again, you are back at {quest_quest_home}.
en.nethack.quest.arc.offeredit.synopsis: [{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} instructs you to guard {quest_quest_artifact} from now on.]
en.nethack.quest.arc.offeredit.text:
{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} touches {quest_quest_artifact} briefly, gazes into it,
then smiles at you and says:

"Well done, {quest_player_name}.  You have defeated {quest_quest_nemesis} and
recovered {quest_quest_artifact}.  But I fear that it shall never be safe
here.

Please take {quest_quest_artifact} with you.  You, {quest_player_name}, can
guard it now far better than I.

May the blessings of {quest_original_alignment_deity} follow you and guard you."
en.nethack.quest.arc.offeredit2.synopsis: ["Resume your search for the Amulet beyond the magic portal to {quest_dungeon_name}."]
en.nethack.quest.arc.offeredit2.text:
"Careful, {quest_player_name}!  {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} might break, and that would be
a tragic loss.  You are its keeper now, and the time has come to
resume your search for the Amulet.  {quest_dungeon_name} await your
return through the magic portal that brought you here."
en.nethack.quest.arc.othertime.text:
You are back at {quest_quest_home}.
You have an odd feeling this may be the last time you ever come here.
en.nethack.quest.arc.posthanks.synopsis: ["Have you progressed with your quest to regain the Amulet of Yendor for {quest_original_alignment_deity}?"]
en.nethack.quest.arc.posthanks.text:
"Welcome back, {quest_player_name}.  Have you progressed with your quest to
regain the Amulet of Yendor for {quest_original_alignment_deity}?"
en.nethack.quest.bar.assignquest.text:
"The world is in great need of your assistance, {quest_player_name}.

"About six months ago, I learned that a mysterious sorcerer, known
as {quest_quest_nemesis}, had begun to gather a large group of cutthroats and brigands
about {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}.

"At about the same time, these people you once rode with `liberated' a
potent magical talisman, {quest_quest_artifact}, from a Turanian caravan.

"{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} and {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} Black Horde swept down upon {quest_intermediate_destination} and defeated
the people there, driving them out into the desert.  He has taken
{quest_quest_artifact}, and seeks to bend it to {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} will.  I detected the
subtle changes in the currents of fate, and joined these people.
Then I sent forth a summons for you.

"If {quest_quest_nemesis} can bend {quest_quest_artifact} to {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} will, he will become
almost indestructible.  He will then be able to enslave the minds of
men across the world.  You are the only hope.  The gods smile upon you,
and with {quest_original_alignment_deity} behind you, you alone can defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}.

"You must go to {quest_intermediate_destination}.  From there, you can track down
{quest_quest_nemesis}, defeat {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}, and return {quest_quest_artifact} to us.  Only
then will the world be safe."
en.nethack.quest.bar.badalign.synopsis: ["You have wandered from the path of the {quest_original_alignment}.  Come back when you have atoned."]
en.nethack.quest.bar.badalign.text:
"{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  You have wandered from the path of the {quest_original_alignment}!
If you attempt to overcome {quest_quest_nemesis} in this state, he will surely
enslave your soul.  Your only hope, and ours, lies in your purification.
Go forth, and return when you feel ready."
en.nethack.quest.bar.badlevel.synopsis: ["You are too inexperienced.  Come back when you are {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a}."]
en.nethack.quest.bar.badlevel.text:
"{quest_player_name}, I fear that you are as yet too inexperienced to face
{quest_quest_nemesis}.  Only {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a} with the help of {quest_original_alignment_deity} could ever hope to
defeat {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}."
en.nethack.quest.bar.discourage.item_1: "My pets will dine on your carcass tonight!"
en.nethack.quest.bar.discourage.item_10: "You have failed, {quest_role_name}.  Now, my victory is complete."
en.nethack.quest.bar.discourage.item_3: "Run while you can, {quest_role_name}.  My next spell will be your last."
en.nethack.quest.bar.discourage.item_4: "I shall use your very skin to bind my next grimoire."
en.nethack.quest.bar.discourage.item_5: "{quest_original_alignment_deity} cannot protect you now.  Here, you die."
en.nethack.quest.bar.discourage.item_6: "Your {quest_original_alignment} nature makes you weak.  You cannot defeat me."
en.nethack.quest.bar.discourage.item_7: "Come, {quest_role_name}.  I shall kill you, then unleash the horde on your tribe."
en.nethack.quest.bar.discourage.item_8: "Once you are dead, my horde shall finish off {quest_quest_leader}, and your tribe."
en.nethack.quest.bar.discourage.item_9: "Fight, {quest_role_name}, or are you afraid of the mighty {quest_quest_nemesis}?"
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_1: "{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} is strong in the dark arts, but not immune to cold steel."
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_10: "You have a great road to travel, {quest_player_name}, but only after you defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}."
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_2: "Remember that {quest_quest_nemesis} is a great sorcerer.  He lived in the time of Atlantis."
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_3: "If you fail, {quest_player_name}, I will not be able to protect these people long."
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_4: "To enter {quest_intermediate_destination}, you must be very stealthy.  The horde will be on guard."
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_5: "Call upon {quest_original_alignment_deity} in your time of need."
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_6: "May {quest_original_alignment_deity} protect you, and guide your steps."
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_7: "If you can lay hands upon {quest_quest_artifact}, carry it for good fortune."
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_8: "I cannot stand against {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} sorcery.  But {quest_original_alignment_deity} will help you."
en.nethack.quest.bar.encourage.item_9: "Do not fear {quest_quest_nemesis}.  I know you can defeat {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}."
en.nethack.quest.bar.firsttime.synopsis: [You reach the vicinity of {quest_quest_home}, but sense evil magic nearby.]
en.nethack.quest.bar.firsttime.text:
Warily you scan your surroundings, all of your senses alert for signs
of possible danger.  Off in the distance, you can {quest_perception_verb} the familiar shapes
of {quest_quest_home}.

But why, you think, should {quest_quest_leader} be there?

Suddenly, the hairs on your neck stand on end as you detect the aura of
evil magic in the air.

Without thought, you ready your weapon, and mutter under your breath:

    "By {quest_original_alignment_deity}, there will be blood spilt today."
en.nethack.quest.bar.goal_first.text:
The hairs on the nape of your neck lift as you sense an energy in the
very air around you.  You fight down a primordial panic that seeks to
make you turn and run.  This is surely the lair of {quest_quest_nemesis}.
en.nethack.quest.bar.goal_next.text: Yet again you feel the air around you heavy with malevolent magical energy.
en.nethack.quest.bar.gotit.synopsis: [You feel the power of {quest_quest_artifact} flowing through your hands.]
en.nethack.quest.bar.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact}, you feel the power of it
flowing through your hands.  It seems to be in two or more places
at once, even though you are holding it.
en.nethack.quest.bar.guardtalk_after.item_1: "The battles here have been good -- our enemies' blood soaks the soil!"
en.nethack.quest.bar.guardtalk_after.item_2: "Remember that glory is crushing your enemies beneath your feet!"
en.nethack.quest.bar.guardtalk_after.item_3: "Times will be good again, now that the horde is vanquished."
en.nethack.quest.bar.guardtalk_after.item_4: "You have brought our clan much honor in defeating {quest_quest_nemesis}."
en.nethack.quest.bar.guardtalk_after.item_5: "You will be a worthy successor to {quest_quest_leader}."
en.nethack.quest.bar.guardtalk_before.item_: "The battles here have been good -- our enemies' blood soaks the soil!"
"Remember that glory is crushing your enemies beneath your feet!"
"There has been little treasure to loot, since the horde arrived."
"The horde is mighty in numbers, but they have little courage."
"{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} is a strange one, but he has helped defend us."
en.nethack.quest.bar.hasamulet.synopsis: ["Take the Amulet to the altar of {quest_original_alignment_deity} on the Astral Plane and offer it."]
en.nethack.quest.bar.hasamulet.text:
"This is wondrous, {quest_player_name}.  I feared that you could not possibly
succeed in your quest, but here you are in possession of the Amulet
of Yendor!

"I have studied the texts of the magi constantly since you left.  In
the Book of Skelos, I found this:

    {quest_original_alignment_deity} will cause a child to be sent into the world.  This child is to
    be made strong by trial of battle and magic, for {quest_original_alignment_deity} has willed it so.
    It is said that the child of {quest_original_alignment_deity} will recover the Amulet of Yendor
    that was stolen from the Creator at the beginning of time.

"As you now possess the amulet, {quest_player_name}, I suspect that the Book
speaks of you.

    The child of {quest_original_alignment_deity} will take the Amulet, and travel to the Astral
    Plane, where the Great Temple of {quest_original_alignment_deity} is to be found.  The Amulet
    will be sacrificed to {quest_original_alignment_deity}, there on {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_J} altar.  Then the child will
    stand by {quest_original_alignment_deity} as champion of all {quest_role_name_modifier_P} for eternity.

"This is all I know, {quest_player_name}.  I hope it will help you."
en.nethack.quest.bar.killed_nemesis.synopsi: [{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} curses you, but you feel the overpowering aura of magic fading.]
en.nethack.quest.bar.killed_nemesis.text:
{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} falls to the ground, and utters a last curse at you.  Then {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j}
body fades slowly, seemingly dispersing into the air around you.  You
slowly become aware that the overpowering aura of magic in the air has
begun to fade.
en.nethack.quest.bar.leader_first.synopsis: ["At last you have returned.  There is a great quest you must undertake."]
en.nethack.quest.bar.leader_first.text:
"Ah, {quest_player_name}.  You have returned at last.  The world is in dire
need of your help.  There is a great quest you must undertake.

"But first, I must see if you are ready to take on such a challenge."
en.nethack.quest.bar.leader_last.synopsis: ["You have betrayed {quest_original_alignment_deity}; soon {quest_quest_nemesis} will destroy us.  Begone!"]
en.nethack.quest.bar.leader_last.text:
"Pah!  You have betrayed the gods, {quest_player_name}.  You will never attain
the glory which you aspire to.  Your failure to follow the true path has
closed this future to you.

"I will protect these people as best I can, but soon {quest_quest_nemesis} will overcome
me and destroy all who once called you {quest_sibling_term}.  Now begone!"
en.nethack.quest.bar.leader_next.text: "{quest_player_name}, you are back.  Are you ready now for the challenge?"
en.nethack.quest.bar.leader_other.text: "Again, you stand before me, {quest_player_name}.  Surely you have prepared yourself."
en.nethack.quest.bar.locate_first.text:
The scent of water comes to you in the desert breeze.  You know that
you have located {quest_intermediate_destination}.
en.nethack.quest.bar.locate_next.text: Yet again you have a chance to infiltrate {quest_intermediate_destination}.
en.nethack.quest.bar.nemesis_first.synopsis: [{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} boasts that {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_h} has slain many.  "Prepare to die, {quest_role_name}."]
en.nethack.quest.bar.nemesis_first.text:
"So.  This is what that second rate sorcerer {quest_quest_leader} sends to do {quest_quest_leader_modifier_j} bidding.
I have slain many before you.  You shall give me little sport.

"Prepare to die, {quest_role_name}."
en.nethack.quest.bar.nemesis_next.text: "I have wasted too much time on you already.  Now, you shall die."
en.nethack.quest.bar.nemesis_other.text: "You return yet again, {quest_role_name}!  Are you prepared for death now?"
en.nethack.quest.bar.nemesis_wantsit.text:
"I shall have {quest_quest_artifact} back, you pitiful excuse for {quest_role_name_modifier_a}.
And your life as well."
en.nethack.quest.bar.nexttime.text:
Once again, you near {quest_quest_home}.  You know that {quest_quest_leader}
will be waiting.
en.nethack.quest.bar.offeredit.synopsis: [{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} tells you to guard {quest_quest_artifact}, and to return when you have triumphed.]
en.nethack.quest.bar.offeredit.text:
When {quest_quest_leader} sees {quest_quest_artifact}, he smiles, and says:

    Well done, {quest_player_name}.  You have saved the world from certain doom.
    What, now, should be done with {quest_quest_artifact}?

    These people, brave as they are, cannot hope to guard it from
    other sorcerers who will detect it, as surely as {quest_quest_nemesis} did.

    Take {quest_quest_artifact} with you, {quest_player_name}.  It will guard you in
    your adventures, and you can best guard it.  You embark on a
    quest far greater than you realize.

    Remember me, {quest_player_name}, and return when you have triumphed.  I
    will tell you then of what you must do.  You will understand when the
    time comes.
en.nethack.quest.bar.offeredit2.synopsis: ["You keep {quest_quest_artifact}.  Return to {quest_dungeon_name} to search for the Amulet."]
en.nethack.quest.bar.offeredit2.text:
{quest_quest_leader} gazes reverently at {quest_quest_artifact}, then back at you.

"You are its keeper now, and the time has come to resume your search
for the Amulet.  {quest_dungeon_name} await your return through the
magic portal which brought you here."
en.nethack.quest.bar.othertime.text:
Again, and you think possibly for the last time, you approach
{quest_quest_home}.
en.nethack.quest.bar.posthanks.text: "Tell us, {quest_player_name}, have you fared well on your great quest?"
en.nethack.quest.cav.assignquest.synopsis: [Find and defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}, recover {quest_quest_artifact}, and return with it.]
en.nethack.quest.cav.assignquest.text:
"You are indeed ready now, {quest_player_name}.  I shall tell you a tale of
great suffering among your people:

"Shortly after you left on your vision quest, the caves were invaded by
the creatures sent against us by {quest_quest_nemesis}.

"She, herself, could not attack us due to her great size, but her minions
have harassed us ever since.  In the first attacks, many died, and the
minions of {quest_quest_nemesis} managed to steal {quest_quest_artifact}.
They took it to {quest_intermediate_destination} and there, none of our
{quest_quest_guardian} warriors have been able to go.

"You must find {quest_intermediate_destination}, and within it wrest
{quest_quest_artifact} from {quest_quest_nemesis}.  She guards it as
jealously as she guards all treasures she attains.  But with it,
we can make our caves safe once more.

"Please, {quest_player_name}, recover {quest_quest_artifact} for us, and return it here."
en.nethack.quest.cav.badalign.synopsis: ["You no longer follow the path of the {quest_original_alignment}.  Go, and purify yourself."]
en.nethack.quest.cav.badalign.text:
"{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  You have deviated from my teachings.  You no longer follow
the path of the {quest_original_alignment} as you should.  I banish you from these caves, to
go forth and purify yourself.  Then, you might be able to accomplish this
quest."
en.nethack.quest.cav.badlevel.synopsis: ["{quest_current_rank_modifier_A} is too inexperienced.  Come back when you have progressed."]
en.nethack.quest.cav.badlevel.text:
"Alas, {quest_player_name}, you are as yet too inexperienced to embark upon such
a difficult quest as that I propose to give you.

"{quest_current_rank_modifier_A} could not possibly survive the rigors demanded to find
{quest_intermediate_destination}, never mind to confront {quest_quest_nemesis} herself.

"Adventure some more, and you will learn the skills you will require.
{quest_original_alignment_deity} decrees it."
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_1: "You are weak, {quest_role_name}.  No challenge for the Mother of all Dragons."
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_10: "{quest_original_alignment_deity} has deserted you, {quest_role_name}.  This is my domain."
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_2: "I grow hungry, {quest_current_rank}.  You look like a nice appetizer!"
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_3: "Join me for lunch?  You're the main course, {quest_role_name}."
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_4: "With {quest_quest_artifact}, I am invincible!  You cannot succeed."
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_5: "Your mentor, {quest_quest_leader} has failed.  You are nothing to fear."
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_6: "You shall die here, {quest_role_name}.  {quest_current_rank_modifier_A} cannot hope to defeat me."
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_7: "You, a mere {quest_current_rank} challenge the might of {quest_quest_nemesis}?  Hah!"
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_8: "I am the Mother of all Dragons!  You cannot hope to defeat me."
en.nethack.quest.cav.discourage.item_9: "My claws are sharp now.  I shall rip you to shreds!"
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_1: "{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} is immune to her own breath weapons. You should use magic upon her that she does not use herself."
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_10: "If only we had an amulet of reflection, this would not have happened."
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_2: "When you encounter {quest_quest_nemesis}, call upon {quest_original_alignment_deity} for assistance."
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_3: "There will be nowhere to hide inside {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} inner sanctum."
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_4: "Your best chance with {quest_quest_nemesis} will be to keep moving."
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_5: "Do not be distracted by the great treasures in {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} lair. Concentrate on {quest_quest_artifact}."
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_6: "{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} is the only object that {quest_quest_nemesis} truly fears."
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_7: "Do not be fooled by {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} size.  She is fast, and it is rumored that she uses magic."
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_8: "I would send a party of {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P} with you, but we will need all of our strength to defend ourselves."
en.nethack.quest.cav.encourage.item_9: "Remember, be {quest_original_alignment} at all times.  This is your strength."
en.nethack.quest.cav.firsttime.synopsis: [You arrive back at {quest_quest_home}, but something is wrong here.]
en.nethack.quest.cav.firsttime.text:
You descend through a barely familiar stairwell that you remember
{quest_quest_leader} showing you when you embarked upon your vision quest.

You arrive back at {quest_quest_home}, but something seems
wrong here.  The usual smoke and glowing light of the fires of the
outer caves are absent, and an uneasy quiet fills the damp air.
en.nethack.quest.cav.goal_first.synopsis: [You enter a large cavern.  {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} is present.]
en.nethack.quest.cav.goal_first.text:
You find yourself in a large cavern, with neatly polished walls, that
nevertheless show signs of being scorched by fire.

Bones litter the floor, and there are objects scattered everywhere.
The air is close with the stench of sulphurous fumes.

{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} is clearly visible, but {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_h} seems to be asleep.
en.nethack.quest.cav.goal_next.text: Once again, you find yourself in the lair of {quest_quest_nemesis}.
en.nethack.quest.cav.gotit.synopsis: [{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} fills you with a feeling of power.]
en.nethack.quest.cav.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact} it seems heavy at first, but as you
hold it strength flows into your arms.

You suddenly feel full of power, as if nothing could possibly stand
in your path.
en.nethack.quest.cav.guardtalk_after.item_1: "The rains have returned and the land grows lush again."
en.nethack.quest.cav.guardtalk_after.item_4: "So, {quest_player_name}, tell us the story of your fight with {quest_quest_nemesis}."
en.nethack.quest.cav.guardtalk_after.item_5: "{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} grows old.  Perhaps you will guide us after he ascends."
en.nethack.quest.cav.guardtalk_before.item_: "We have not been able to gather as much food since the Giants sealed off our access to the outer world."
"Since {quest_quest_nemesis} sent her minions, we have been constantly fighting."
"I have heard your vision quest was successful.  Is this so?"
"So, tell me, {quest_player_name}, how have you fared?"
"{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} grows old.  We know not who will guide us after he ascends."
en.nethack.quest.cav.hasamulet.synopsis: ["Take the Amulet to the altar of {quest_original_alignment_deity} on the Astral Plane and offer it."]
en.nethack.quest.cav.hasamulet.text:
"You have been successful, I see, {quest_player_name}.

"Now that the Amulet of Yendor is yours, here is what you must do:

"Journey upwards to the open air.  The Amulet you carry will then
take you into the Astral Planes, where the Great Temple of {quest_original_alignment_deity}
casts its influence throughout our world.

"Sacrifice the Amulet on the altar.  Thus shall {quest_original_alignment_deity} become supreme!"
en.nethack.quest.cav.killed_nemesis.text:
{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} sinks to the ground, her heads flailing about.
As she dies, a cloud of noxious fumes billows about her.
en.nethack.quest.cav.leader_first.synopsis: ["You have returned.  We are in dire need of your help."]
en.nethack.quest.cav.leader_first.text:
"You have returned from your vision quest, {quest_player_name}.  Thank {quest_original_alignment_deity}.

"We are in dire need of your help, my {quest_child_term}.

"But first, I must see if you are yet capable of the quest I would
ask you to undertake."
en.nethack.quest.cav.leader_last.text:
"{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  You have sealed our fate.  You seem unable to reform yourself,
so I must select another to take your place.

"Begone from {quest_quest_home}!  You have betrayed us by choosing
the path of the {quest_chaotic_alignment} over the true path of the {quest_lawful_alignment}.

"You no longer live in our eyes."
en.nethack.quest.cav.leader_next.text: "Again, you return to us, {quest_player_name}.  Let me see if you are ready now."
en.nethack.quest.cav.locate_first.synopsis: [You {quest_perception_verb} many large claw marks, smell carrion, and notice bones.]
en.nethack.quest.cav.locate_first.text:
You {quest_perception_verb} many large claw marks on the ground.  The tunnels ahead
of you are larger than most of those in any cave complex you have
ever been in before.

Your nose detects the smell of carrion from within, and bones litter
the sides of the tunnels.
en.nethack.quest.cav.nemesis_first.text:
"So, follower of {quest_quest_leader}, you seek to invade the lair of
{quest_quest_nemesis}.  Only my meals are allowed down here.  Prepare
to be eaten!"
en.nethack.quest.cav.nemesis_next.text:
"So, again you face me, {quest_role_name}.  No one has ever before escaped me.
Now I shall kill you."
en.nethack.quest.cav.nemesis_other.text: "You are getting annoying, {quest_role_name}.  Prepare to die."
en.nethack.quest.cav.nemesis_wantsit.text: "I'll have {quest_quest_artifact} from you, {quest_role_name}.  You shall die."
en.nethack.quest.cav.nexttime.text: Once again, you arrive back at {quest_quest_home}.
en.nethack.quest.cav.offeredit.synopsis: ["Take {quest_quest_artifact} with you.  It will help in your quest for the Amulet of Yendor."]
en.nethack.quest.cav.offeredit.text:
{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} glimpses {quest_quest_artifact} in your possession.
He smiles and says:

    You have done it!  We are saved.  But I fear that {quest_quest_artifact}
    will always be a target for {quest_chaotic_alignment} forces who will want it for their
    own.

    To prevent further trouble, I would like you, {quest_player_name},
    to take {quest_quest_artifact} away with you.  It will help you as you
    quest for the Amulet of Yendor.
en.nethack.quest.cav.offeredit2.synopsis: ["You are the keeper of {quest_quest_artifact} now.  Return to {quest_dungeon_name} to search for the Amulet.]
en.nethack.quest.cav.offeredit2.text:
{quest_quest_leader} grasps {quest_quest_artifact} proudly for a moment, then looks at you.

"You are its keeper now, and the time has come to resume your search
for the Amulet.  {quest_dungeon_name} await your return through the
magic portal which brought you here."
en.nethack.quest.cav.othertime.text:
For some reason, you think that this may be the last time you will
enter {quest_quest_home}.
en.nethack.quest.cav.posthanks.text:
"{quest_player_name_modifier_C}!  Welcome back.
How goes your quest to recover the Amulet for {quest_original_alignment_deity}?"
en.nethack.quest.common.angel_cuss.item_13: "Thou shalt be brought before {quest_lawful_deity} for thy crimes!"
en.nethack.quest.common.angel_cuss.item_14: "With {quest_lawful_deity} as my witness, I shall strike thee down."
en.nethack.quest.common.angel_cuss.item_3: "Very soon, my child, thou shalt meet thy maker."
en.nethack.quest.common.angel_cuss.item_4: "The great {quest_lawful_deity} has sent me to make you pay for your sins!"
en.nethack.quest.common.angel_cuss.item_5: "The wrath of {quest_lawful_deity} is now upon you!"
en.nethack.quest.common.angel_cuss.item_7: "Dost thou wish to receive thy final blessing?"
en.nethack.quest.common.angel_cuss.item_9: "Thou art not worthy to seek the Amulet."
en.nethack.quest.common.banished.synopsis: [You are banished from {quest_quest_home} for betraying your allegiance to {quest_original_alignment_deity}.]
en.nethack.quest.common.banished.text:
"You have betrayed all those who hold allegiance to {quest_original_alignment_deity}, as you once did.
My allegiance to {quest_original_alignment_deity} holds fast and I cannot condone or accept what you
have done.

Leave this place.  You shall never set foot at {quest_quest_home} again.
That which you seek is now lost forever, for without the Bell of Opening,
you will never be able to enter the place where he who has the Amulet
resides.

Go now!  You are banished from this place.
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_1: "I first mistook thee for a statue, when I regarded thy head of stone."
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_12: "Mercy!  Dost thou wish me to die of laughter?"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_13: "Run away!  Live to flee another day!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_14: "Thou hadst best fight better than thou canst dress!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_15: "Twixt thy cousin and thee, Medusa is the prettier."
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_16: "Methinks thou wert unnaturally stirred by yon corpse back there, eh, varlet?"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_17: "Up thy nose with a rubber hose!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_18: "Verily, thy corpse could not smell worse!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_19: "Wait!  I shall polymorph into a grid bug to give thee a fighting chance!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_20: "Why search for the Amulet?  Thou wouldst but lose it, cretin."
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_21: "Thou ought to be a comedian, thy skills are so laughable!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_22: "Thy gaze is so vacant, I thought thee a floating eye!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_23: "Thy head is unfit for a mind flayer to munch upon!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_26: "Hold! Thy face is a most exquisite torture!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_27: "I should fart in thy direction, but it might improve thy smell!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_3: "Doth pain excite thee?  Wouldst thou prefer the whip?"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_4: "Thinkest thou it shall tickle as I rip out thy lungs?"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_6: "Go ahead, fetch thy mama!  I shall wait."
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_7: "Go play leapfrog with a herd of unicorns!"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_8: "Hast thou been drinking, or art thou always so clumsy?"
en.nethack.quest.common.demon_cuss.item_9: "This time I shall let thee off with a spanking, but let it not happen again."
en.nethack.quest.common.legacy.synopsis: [{quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_C} has chosen you to recover the Amulet of Yendor for {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_I}.]
en.nethack.quest.common.legacy.text:
It is written in the Book of {quest_original_alignment_deity}:

    After the Creation, the cruel god Moloch rebelled
    against the authority of Marduk the Creator.
    Moloch stole from Marduk the most powerful of all
    the artifacts of the gods, the Amulet of Yendor,
    and he hid it in the dark cavities of Gehennom, the
    Under World, where he now lurks, and bides his time.

Your {quest_alignment_title} {quest_original_alignment_deity} seeks to possess the Amulet, and with it
to gain deserved ascendance over the other gods.

You, a newly trained {quest_current_rank}, have been heralded
from birth as the instrument of {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  You are destined
to recover the Amulet for your deity, or die in the
attempt.  Your hour of destiny has come.  For the sake
of us all:  Go bravely with {quest_original_alignment_deity}!
en.nethack.quest.common.pauper_legacy.synop: [{quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_C} has chosen you to recover the Amulet of Yendor for {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_I}.]
en.nethack.quest.common.pauper_legacy.text:
It is written in the Book of {quest_original_alignment_deity}:

    After the Creation, the cruel god Moloch rebelled
    against the authority of Marduk the Creator.
    Moloch stole from Marduk the most powerful of all
    the artifacts of the gods, the Amulet of Yendor,
    and he hid it in the dark cavities of Gehennom, the
    Under World, where he now lurks, and bides his time.

Your {quest_alignment_title} {quest_original_alignment_deity} seeks to possess the Amulet, and with it
to gain deserved ascendance over the other gods.

You, an untrained {quest_current_rank}, have been unable to adequately
prepare to be the instrument of {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  Nevertheless, you
are destined to recover the Amulet for your deity, or die
in the attempt.  Your hour of destiny has come.  For the
sake of us all:  Go bravely with {quest_original_alignment_deity}!
en.nethack.quest.common.quest_complete_no_b:
"The silver bell which was hoarded by {quest_quest_nemesis} will be
essential in locating the Amulet of Yendor."
en.nethack.quest.common.quest_portal.text:
You receive a faint telepathic message from {quest_quest_leader}:
Your help is urgently needed at {quest_quest_home}!
Look for a ...ic transporter.
You couldn't quite make out that last message.
You again sense {quest_quest_leader} pleading for help.
en.nethack.quest.common.quest_portal_demand: You again sense {quest_quest_leader} demanding your attendance.
en.nethack.quest.hea.assignquest.synopsis: [Travel to {quest_intermediate_destination} on your way to recover {quest_quest_artifact} from {quest_quest_nemesis}.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.assignquest.text:
For the first time, you sense a smile on {quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} face.

    "You have indeed learned as much as we can teach you in preparation
    for this task.  Let me tell you what I know of the symptoms and hope
    that you can provide a cure.

    "A short while ago, the dreaded {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_t} was fooled by the gods
    into thinking that {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_h} could use {quest_quest_artifact} to find a
    cure for old age.  Think of it, eternal youth!  But {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} good
    health is accomplished by drawing the health from those around {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}.

    "He has exhausted {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} own supply of healthy people and now {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_h} seeks to
    extend {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} influence into our world.  You must recover from {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}
    {quest_quest_artifact} and break the spell.

    "You must travel into the swamps to {quest_intermediate_destination}, and from there
    follow the trail to {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} island lair.  Be careful."
en.nethack.quest.hea.badalign.text:
"You have learned much of the remedies that benefit, but you must also
know which physic for which ail.  That is why {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_s} teachings are a
part of your training.

"Return to us when you have healed thyself."
en.nethack.quest.hea.badlevel.synopsis: [You are too inexperienced.  Return when you are {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a}.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.badlevel.text:
"Alas, {quest_player_name}, you are yet too inexperienced to deal with the rigors
of such a task.  You must be able to draw on the knowledge of botany,
alchemy and veterinary practices before I can send you on this quest 
with good conscience.

"Return when you wear {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a}'s caduceus."
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_1: "They might as well give scalpels to wizards as to let you try to use {quest_quest_artifact}!"
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_10: "You should have stopped studying at veterinary."
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_2: "If I could strike {quest_quest_leader}, surrounded by {quest_quest_leader_modifier_j} {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P}, imagine what I can do to you here by yourself."
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_3: "I will put my {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_p} to work making a physic out of your ashes."
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_4: "As we speak, Hades gathers your patients to join you."
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_5: "After I'm done with you, I'll destroy {quest_quest_leader} as well."
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_6: "You will have to kill me if you ever hope to leave this place."
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_7: "I will impale your head on my caduceus for all to see."
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_8: "There is no materia medica in your sack which will cure you of me!"
en.nethack.quest.hea.discourage.item_9: "Do not fight too hard, I want your soul strong, not weakened!"
en.nethack.quest.hea.encourage.item_1: "Remember, {quest_player_name}, to always wash your hands before operating."
en.nethack.quest.hea.encourage.item_10: "With but one eye, {quest_quest_nemesis} should be easy to blind.  Remember this."
en.nethack.quest.hea.encourage.item_2: "{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} has no real magic of {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} own.  To this {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_h} is vulnerable."
en.nethack.quest.hea.encourage.item_3: "If you have been true to {quest_original_alignment_deity}, you can draw on the power of {quest_quest_artifact}."
en.nethack.quest.hea.encourage.item_5: "Remember this, {quest_quest_nemesis} can twist the powers of {quest_quest_artifact} to hurt instead of heal."
en.nethack.quest.hea.encourage.item_6: "I have sent for Chiron, but I am afraid he will come too late."
en.nethack.quest.hea.encourage.item_7: "Maybe when you return the snakes will once again begin to shed."
en.nethack.quest.hea.encourage.item_8: "The plague grows worse as we speak.  Hurry, {quest_player_name}!"
en.nethack.quest.hea.encourage.item_9: "Many times {quest_quest_nemesis} has caused trouble in these lands.  It is time that {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_h} was eradicated like the diseases {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_h} has caused."
en.nethack.quest.hea.firsttime.synopsis: [You arrive back at {quest_quest_home} and must find {quest_quest_leader}.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.firsttime.text:
What sorcery has brought you back to {quest_quest_home}?  The smell
of fresh funeral pyres tells you that something is amiss with the healing
powers that used to practice here.

No rhizotomists are tending the materia medica gardens, and where are the
common folk who used to come for the cures?

You know that you must quickly make your way to the collegium, and
{quest_quest_leader_modifier_s} iatreion, and find out what has happened in your absence.
en.nethack.quest.hea.goal_first.synopsis: [You have reached the lair of {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Take {quest_quest_artifact} away from {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.goal_first.text:
You stand within sight of the infamous Isle of {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Even
the words of {quest_quest_leader} had not prepared you for this.

Steeling yourself against the wails of the ill that pierce your ears,
you hurry on your task.  Maybe with {quest_quest_artifact} you can
heal them on your return, but not now.
en.nethack.quest.hea.goal_next.text: Once again, you {quest_perception_verb} the Isle of {quest_quest_nemesis} in the distance.
en.nethack.quest.hea.gotit.synopsis: [You feel the healing power of {quest_quest_artifact} and should return it to {quest_quest_leader}.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact}, you feel its healing begin to
warm your soul.  You curse Zeus for taking it from its rightful owner,
but at least you hope that {quest_quest_leader} can put it to good use once
again.
en.nethack.quest.hea.guardtalk_after.item_1: "Did you read that new treatise on the therapeutic use of leeches?"
en.nethack.quest.hea.guardtalk_after.item_2: "Paint a red caduceus on your shield and monsters won't hit you."
en.nethack.quest.hea.guardtalk_after.item_3: "How are you feeling?  Perhaps a good bleeding will improve your spirits."
en.nethack.quest.hea.guardtalk_after.item_4: "Have you heard the absurd new theory that diseases are caused by microscopic organisms, and not ill humors?"
en.nethack.quest.hea.guardtalk_after.item_5: "I see that you bring {quest_quest_artifact}, now you can cure this plague!"
en.nethack.quest.hea.guardtalk_before.item_: "Did you read that new treatise on the therapeutic use of leeches?"
"Paint a red caduceus on your shield and monsters won't hit you."
"I passed handwriting so they are demoting me a rank."
"I've heard that even {quest_quest_leader} has not been able to cure Chiron."
"We think {quest_quest_nemesis} has used {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} alchemists, and {quest_quest_artifact}, to unleash a new disease we call 'the cold' on Gehennom."
en.nethack.quest.hea.hasamulet.synopsis: ["You have recovered the Amulet.  Travel to the Astral Plane and return it to {quest_original_alignment_deity}."]
en.nethack.quest.hea.hasamulet.text:
"Ah, you have recovered the Amulet, {quest_player_name}.  Well done!

"Now, you should know that you must travel through the Elemental Planes
to the Astral, and there return the Amulet to {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  Go forth and
may our prayers be as a wind upon your back."
en.nethack.quest.hea.killed_nemesis.text:
The battered body of {quest_quest_nemesis} slumps to the ground and gasps
out one last curse:

    "You have defeated me, {quest_player_name}, but I shall have my revenge.
    How, I shall not say, but this curse shall be like a cancer
    on you."

With that {quest_quest_nemesis} dies.
en.nethack.quest.hea.leader_first.synopsis: [{quest_quest_leader} is weak from the struggle with {quest_quest_nemesis}.  {quest_quest_leader_modifier_H} wants to examine you.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.leader_first.text:
Feebly, {quest_quest_leader} raises {quest_quest_leader_modifier_j} head to look at you.

"It is good to see you again, {quest_player_name}.  I see the concern in your
eyes, but do not worry for me.  I am not ready for Hades yet.  We have
exhausted much of our healing powers holding off {quest_quest_nemesis}.
I need your fresh strength to carry on our work.

"Come closer and let me lay hands on you, and determine if you have
the skills necessary to accomplish this mission."
en.nethack.quest.hea.leader_last.synopsis: [You are a failure as a healer.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.leader_last.text:
"You have failed us, {quest_player_name}.  You are a quack!  A charlatan!

"Hades will be happy to hear that you are once again practicing your
arts on the unsuspecting."
en.nethack.quest.hea.leader_next.text:
"Again you return to me, {quest_player_name}.  I sense that each trip back
the pleurisy and maladies of our land begin to infect you.  Let us
hope and pray to {quest_original_alignment_deity} that you become ready for your task before
you fall victim to the bad humors."
en.nethack.quest.hea.leader_other.text:
"Chiron has fallen, Hermes has fallen, what else must I tell you to
impress upon you the importance of your mission!  I hope that you
have come prepared this time."
en.nethack.quest.hea.locate_first.synopsis: [You have reached {quest_intermediate_destination} but all is not well.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.locate_first.text:
You stand before the entrance to {quest_intermediate_destination}.  Strange
scratching noises come from within the building.

The swampy ground around you seems to stink with disease.
en.nethack.quest.hea.locate_next.text: Once again you stand at the entrance to {quest_intermediate_destination}.
en.nethack.quest.hea.nemesis_first.synopsis: ["I will take your life, then defeat {quest_quest_leader}."]
en.nethack.quest.hea.nemesis_first.text:
"They have made a mistake in sending you, {quest_player_name}.

"When I add your youth to mine, it will just make it easier for me
to defeat {quest_quest_leader}."
en.nethack.quest.hea.nemesis_next.text: "Unlike your patients, you seem to keep coming back, {quest_player_name}!"
en.nethack.quest.hea.nemesis_other.text: "Which would you like, {quest_player_name}?  Boils, pleurisy, convulsions?"
en.nethack.quest.hea.nemesis_wantsit.text:
"I'll have {quest_quest_artifact} back from you, {quest_current_rank}.  You are
not going to live to escape this place."
en.nethack.quest.hea.nexttime.text:
After your last experience you expected to be here, but you certainly
did not expect to see things so much worse.  This time you must succeed.
en.nethack.quest.hea.offeredit.synopsis: [{quest_quest_leader} touches {quest_quest_artifact} and tells {quest_quest_leader_modifier_j} {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P} to do so too, then tells you to take it with you.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.offeredit.text:
As soon as {quest_quest_leader} sees {quest_quest_artifact} {quest_quest_leader_modifier_h} summons {quest_quest_leader_modifier_j}
{quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P}.

Gently, {quest_quest_leader} reaches out and touches {quest_quest_artifact}.
He instructs each of the assembled to do the same.  When everyone
has finished {quest_quest_leader_modifier_h} speaks to you.

    "Now that we have been replenished we can defeat this plague.  You must
    take {quest_quest_artifact} with you and replenish the worlds you have
    been called upon to travel next.  I wish you could ride Chiron to the
    end of your journey, but I need him to help me spread the cure.  Go
    now and continue your journey."
en.nethack.quest.hea.offeredit2.synopsis: [{quest_quest_leader} tells you to keep {quest_quest_artifact} and return to {quest_dungeon_name} to search for the Amulet.]
en.nethack.quest.hea.offeredit2.text:
{quest_quest_leader} cautiously handles {quest_quest_artifact} while watching you.

"You are its keeper now, and the time has come to resume your search
for the Amulet.  {quest_dungeon_name} await your return through the
magic portal which brought you here."
en.nethack.quest.hea.othertime.text:
Again, you {quest_perception_verb} {quest_quest_home} in the distance.

The smell of death and disease permeates the air.  You do not have
to be {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a} to know that {quest_quest_nemesis} is on the verge of victory.
en.nethack.quest.hea.posthanks.text:
"You have again returned to us, {quest_player_name}.  We have done well in your
absence, yes?  How fare you upon your quest for the Amulet?"
en.nethack.quest.kni.assignquest.synopsis: [Pass through {quest_intermediate_destination} to reach {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Destroy {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i} and return with {quest_quest_artifact}.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.assignquest.text:
"Ah, {quest_player_name}.  Thou art truly ready, as no {quest_role_name} before thee hath
been.  Hear now Our words:

"As thou noticed as thou approached {quest_quest_home}, a great battle hath
been fought recently in these fields.  Know thou that Merlin himself
came to aid Us here as We battled the foul {quest_quest_nemesis}.  In the midst of that
battle, {quest_quest_nemesis} struck Merlin a great blow, felling him.  Then, as Our
forces were pressed back, {quest_quest_nemesis} stole {quest_quest_artifact}.

"We eventually turned the tide, but lost many {quest_role_name_modifier_P} in doing so.
Merlin was taken off by his apprentice, but hath not recovered.  We have
been told that so long as {quest_quest_nemesis} possesseth {quest_quest_artifact},
Merlin will not regain his health.

"We hereby charge thee with this most important of duties:

"Go forth from this place, to the fens, and there thou wilt find
{quest_intermediate_destination}.  From there, thou must track down {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Destroy the
beast, and return to Us {quest_quest_artifact}.  Only then can
We restore Merlin to health."
en.nethack.quest.kni.badalign.synopsis: [Go and do penance.  Return when you are truly {quest_original_alignment}.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.badalign.text:
"Thou dishonourest Us, {quest_player_name}!  Thou hast strayed from the path of
chivalry! Go from Our presence and do penance.  Only when thou art again
pure mayst thou return hence."
en.nethack.quest.kni.badlevel.synopsis: [You are not prepared to face {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Return when you are {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a}.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.badlevel.text:
"Verily, {quest_player_name}, thou hast done well.  That thou hast survived thus
far is a credit to thy valor, but thou art yet unprepared for
the demands required as Our Champion.  {quest_current_rank_modifier_A}, no matter how
pure, could never hope to defeat the foul {quest_quest_nemesis}.

"Journey forth from this place, and hone thy skills.  Return to
Our presence when thou hast attained the noble title of {quest_minimum_quest_rank}."
en.nethack.quest.kni.discourage.item_10: "Call upon thy precious {quest_original_alignment_deity}, {quest_player_name}.  It shall not avail thee."
en.nethack.quest.kni.discourage.item_2: "I shall kill thee now, and feast!"
en.nethack.quest.kni.discourage.item_3: "Puny {quest_role_name}.  What manner of death dost thou wish?"
en.nethack.quest.kni.discourage.item_4: "First thee, {quest_player_name}, then I shall feast upon {quest_quest_leader}."
en.nethack.quest.kni.discourage.item_5: "Hah!  Thou hast failed, {quest_current_rank}.  Now thou shalt die."
en.nethack.quest.kni.discourage.item_6: "Die, {quest_role_name}.  Thou art as nothing against my might."
en.nethack.quest.kni.discourage.item_7: "I shall suck the marrow from thy bones, {quest_role_name}."
en.nethack.quest.kni.discourage.item_8: "Let's see...  Baked?  No.  Fried?  Nay.  Broiled?  Yea verily, that is the way I like my {quest_role_name} for dinner."
en.nethack.quest.kni.discourage.item_9: "Thy strength waneth, {quest_player_name}.  The time of thy death draweth near."
en.nethack.quest.kni.encourage.item_10: "To find {quest_intermediate_destination}, thou must keep thy heart pure."
en.nethack.quest.kni.encourage.item_2: "Though {quest_quest_nemesis} is verily a mighty foe, We have confidence in thy victory."
en.nethack.quest.kni.encourage.item_3: "Beware, for {quest_quest_nemesis} hath surrounded {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i}self with hordes of foul creatures."
en.nethack.quest.kni.encourage.item_4: "Great treasure, 'tis said, is hoarded in the lair of {quest_quest_nemesis}."
en.nethack.quest.kni.encourage.item_5: "If thou possessest {quest_quest_artifact}, {quest_player_name}, {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} magic shall therewith be thwarted."
en.nethack.quest.kni.encourage.item_6: "The gates of {quest_intermediate_destination} are guarded by forces unseen, {quest_player_name}. Go carefully."
en.nethack.quest.kni.encourage.item_9: "Call upon {quest_original_alignment_deity} when thou art in need."
en.nethack.quest.kni.firsttime.synopsis: [Signs of battle include long gouges in the walls of {quest_quest_home}.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.firsttime.text:
You materialize in the shadows of {quest_quest_home}.  Immediately, you notice
that something is wrong.  The fields around the castle are trampled and
withered, as if some great battle has been recently fought.

Exploring further, you {quest_perception_verb} long gouges in the walls of {quest_quest_home}.
You know of only one creature that makes those kinds of marks...
en.nethack.quest.kni.goal_first.synopsis: [You {quest_perception_verb} the entrance to a cavern inside a hill.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.goal_first.text:
As you exit the swamps, you {quest_perception_verb} before you a huge, gaping hole in the
side of a hill.  From within, you smell the foul stench of carrion.

The pools on either side of the entrance are fouled with blood, and
pieces of rusted metal and broken weapons show above the surface.
en.nethack.quest.kni.goal_next.text: Again, you stand at the entrance to {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} lair.
en.nethack.quest.kni.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact}, you feel its protective fields
form around your body.  You also feel a faint stirring in your mind, as
if you are in two places at once, and in the second, you are waking from
a long sleep.
en.nethack.quest.kni.guardtalk_after.item_2: "So, {quest_player_name}, didst thou find {quest_quest_nemesis} in the fens near {quest_intermediate_destination}?"
en.nethack.quest.kni.guardtalk_after.item_3: "Worthy {quest_player_name}, hast thou proven thy right purpose on the body of {quest_quest_nemesis}?"
en.nethack.quest.kni.guardtalk_before.item_: "There is word, {quest_player_name}, that {quest_quest_nemesis} hath been sighted in the fens near {quest_intermediate_destination}."
en.nethack.quest.kni.hasamulet.synopsis: [Take the Amulet to the Astral Plane and deliver it to {quest_original_alignment_deity}.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.hasamulet.text:
"Thou hast succeeded, We see, {quest_player_name}!  Now thou art commanded to take
the Amulet to be sacrificed to {quest_original_alignment_deity} in the Plane of the Astral.

"Merlin hath counseled Us that thou must travel always upwards through
the Planes of the Elements, to achieve this goal.

"Go with {quest_original_alignment_deity}, {quest_player_name}."
en.nethack.quest.kni.killed_nemesis.text:
As {quest_quest_nemesis} sinks to the ground, blood gushing from {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} open mouth, {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_h}
defiantly curses you and {quest_quest_leader}:

    "Thou hast not won yet, {quest_current_rank}.  By the gods, I shall return
    and dog thy steps to the grave!"

{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_J} tail flailing madly, {quest_quest_nemesis} tries to crawl towards you, but slumps
to the ground and dies in a pool of {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_j} own blood.
en.nethack.quest.kni.leader_first.synopsis: [{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} checks whether you are ready for a great undertaking.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.leader_first.text:
"Ah, {quest_player_name}.  We see thou hast received Our summons.
We are in dire need of thy prowess.  But first, We must needs
decide if thou art ready for this great undertaking."
en.nethack.quest.kni.leader_last.text:
"Thou disgracest this noble court with thine impure presence.  We have been
lenient with thee, but no more.  Thy name shall be spoken no more.  We
hereby strip thee of thy title, thy lands, and thy standing as {quest_role_name_modifier_a}.
Begone from Our sight!"
en.nethack.quest.kni.leader_next.text: "Welcome again, {quest_player_name}.  We hope thou art ready now."
en.nethack.quest.kni.leader_other.text: "Once again, thou standest before Us, {quest_player_name}.  Art thou ready now?"
en.nethack.quest.kni.locate_first.synopsis: [You have reached {quest_intermediate_destination} and can {quest_perception_verb} a shrine.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.locate_first.text:
You stand at the foot of {quest_intermediate_destination}.  Atop, you can {quest_perception_verb} a shrine.
Strange energies seem to be focused here, and the hair on the back of
your neck stands on end.
en.nethack.quest.kni.locate_next.text: Again, you stand at the foot of {quest_intermediate_destination}.
en.nethack.quest.kni.nemesis_first.synopsis: [{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} taunts you and issues a threat against {quest_quest_home}.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.nemesis_first.text:
"Hah!  Another puny {quest_role_name} seeks death.  I shall dine well tonight,
then tomorrow, {quest_quest_home} shall fall!"
en.nethack.quest.kni.nemesis_next.text: "Again, thou challengest me, {quest_current_rank}?  So be it.  Thou wilt die here."
en.nethack.quest.kni.nemesis_other.text: "Thou art truly foolish, {quest_current_rank}.  I shall dispatch thee anon."
en.nethack.quest.kni.nemesis_wantsit.text:
"So, thou darest touch MY property!  I shall have that bauble back,
puny {quest_current_rank}.  Thou wilt die in agony!"
en.nethack.quest.kni.nexttime.text: Once again you stand in the shadows of {quest_quest_home}.
en.nethack.quest.kni.offeredit.synopsis: [{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} is yours now.  It will aid in your search for the Amulet.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.offeredit.text:
As you approach {quest_quest_leader}, {quest_quest_leader_modifier_h} beams at you and says:

    "Well done!  Thou art truly the Champion of {quest_quest_home}.  We
    have received word that Merlin is recovering, and shall soon
    rejoin Us.

    "He hath instructed Us that thou art now to be the guardian of
    {quest_quest_artifact}.  He feeleth that thou mayst have need of
    its powers in thine adventures.  It is Our wish that thou keepest
    {quest_quest_artifact} with thee as thou searchest for the fabled
    Amulet of Yendor."
en.nethack.quest.kni.offeredit2.synopsis: [You are the keeper of {quest_quest_artifact}.  Return to {quest_dungeon_name} and find the Amulet.]
en.nethack.quest.kni.offeredit2.text:
"Careful, {quest_player_name}!  {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} might break, and that would
be a tragic loss.  Thou art its keeper now, and the time hath come
to resume thy search for the Amulet.  {quest_dungeon_name} await thy
return through the magic portal that brought thee here."
en.nethack.quest.kni.othertime.text:
Again, you stand before {quest_quest_home}.  You vaguely sense that this
may be the last time you stand before {quest_quest_leader}.
en.nethack.quest.kni.posthanks.text: "Well met, {quest_player_name}.  How goeth thy search for the Amulet of Yendor?"
en.nethack.quest.mon.assignquest.synopsis: [Find {quest_intermediate_destination}, then continue to {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} lair.  Defeat {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i} and return with {quest_quest_artifact}.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.assignquest.text:
"Yes, {quest_player_name}.  You are truly ready now.  Attend to me and I shall
tell you of what has transpired:

"During one of the Great Meditations a short time ago, {quest_quest_nemesis} and
a legion of elementals invaded {quest_quest_home}.  Many {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P}
were killed, including the one bearing {quest_quest_artifact}.

Now, there are barely enough {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P} left to keep the elementals
at bay.

"We need you to find {quest_intermediate_destination}, then, from there,
travel to {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} lair.  If you can manage to defeat {quest_quest_nemesis} and
return {quest_quest_artifact} here, we can then drive off the legions
of elementals that slay our students.

"Go with {quest_original_alignment_deity} as your guide, {quest_player_name}."
en.nethack.quest.mon.badalign.synopsis: [You must atone.  Come back when you are worthy of {quest_original_alignment_deity}.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.badalign.text:
"This is terrible, {quest_player_name}.  You have deviated from the true path!
You know that {quest_original_alignment_deity} requires the most strident devotion of this
order.  The {quest_sibling_term}hood must stand for utmost piety.

"Go from here, atone for your sins against {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  Return only when
you have purified yourself."
en.nethack.quest.mon.badlevel.synopsis: [You are not ready to face {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Come back when you are {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a}.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.badlevel.text:
"Alas, {quest_player_name}, it is not yet to be.  A mere {quest_current_rank} could never
withstand the might of {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Go forth, again into the world, and
return when you have attained the post of {quest_minimum_quest_rank}."
en.nethack.quest.mon.discourage.item_1: "Submit to my will, {quest_role_name}, and I shall spare you."
en.nethack.quest.mon.discourage.item_10: "With {quest_quest_artifact}, nothing can stand in my way."
en.nethack.quest.mon.discourage.item_2: "Your puny powers are no match for me, {quest_role_name}."
en.nethack.quest.mon.discourage.item_3: "I shall have you turned into a zombie for my pleasure!"
en.nethack.quest.mon.discourage.item_5: "I shall feast upon your soul for many days, {quest_role_name}."
en.nethack.quest.mon.discourage.item_6: "Your death will be slow and painful.  That I promise!"
en.nethack.quest.mon.discourage.item_7: "You cannot defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}, you fool.  I shall kill you now."
en.nethack.quest.mon.discourage.item_8: "Your precious {quest_quest_leader_modifier_t} will be my next victim."
en.nethack.quest.mon.discourage.item_9: "I feel your powers failing you, {quest_current_rank}.  You shall die now."
en.nethack.quest.mon.encourage.item_1: "You can prevail, if you rely on {quest_original_alignment_deity}."
en.nethack.quest.mon.encourage.item_10: "Wear {quest_quest_artifact}.  They will assist you in your efforts."
en.nethack.quest.mon.encourage.item_2: "Remember that {quest_quest_nemesis} has great magic at his command."
en.nethack.quest.mon.encourage.item_4: "Beware, {quest_intermediate_destination} is surrounded by hordes of earth elementals."
en.nethack.quest.mon.encourage.item_5: "Remember your studies, and you will prevail!"
en.nethack.quest.mon.encourage.item_6: "Acquire and wear {quest_quest_artifact} if you can.  They will aid you against {quest_quest_nemesis}."
en.nethack.quest.mon.encourage.item_7: "Call upon {quest_original_alignment_deity} when your need is greatest.  You will be answered."
en.nethack.quest.mon.encourage.item_8: "Remember to use the elementals' strength against them!"
en.nethack.quest.mon.encourage.item_9: "Do not lose faith, {quest_player_name}.  If you do so, {quest_quest_nemesis} will grow stronger."
en.nethack.quest.mon.firsttime.synopsis: [You have reached {quest_quest_home} but something is wrong.  {quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} needs your aid.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.firsttime.text:
You find yourself standing in sight of {quest_quest_home}.
Something is obviously wrong here.  Strange shapes lumber around
outside {quest_quest_home}!

You realize that {quest_quest_leader} needs your assistance!
en.nethack.quest.mon.goal_first.synopsis: [You are surrounded by brimstone, lava, and elementals.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.goal_first.text:
The stench of brimstone is all about you, and the elementals close in
from all sides!

Ahead, there is a small clearing amidst the bubbling pits of lava...
en.nethack.quest.mon.gotit.synopsis: [You feel the essence of {quest_original_alignment_deity} and realize that you should take {quest_quest_artifact} to {quest_quest_leader}.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.gotit.text:
As you pick up {quest_quest_artifact}, you feel the essence of
{quest_original_alignment_deity} fill your soul.  You know now why {quest_quest_nemesis} stole {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_i} from
{quest_quest_home}, for with {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_i}, {quest_role_name_modifier_a} of {quest_original_alignment_deity} could
easily defeat his plans.

You sense a message from {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  Though not verbal, you
get the impression that you must return to {quest_quest_leader} as soon
as possible.
en.nethack.quest.mon.guardtalk_after.item_1: "Greetings, honorable {quest_current_rank}.  It is good to see you again."
en.nethack.quest.mon.guardtalk_after.item_2: "Ah, {quest_player_name}!  Our deepest gratitude for all of your help."
en.nethack.quest.mon.guardtalk_after.item_3: "Greetings, {quest_sibling_term}.  Perhaps you will take some time to meditate with us?"
en.nethack.quest.mon.guardtalk_after.item_4: "With this test behind you, may {quest_original_alignment_deity} bring you enlightenment."
en.nethack.quest.mon.guardtalk_before.item_: "Greetings, honorable {quest_current_rank}.  It is good to see you."
"Ah, {quest_player_name}!  Surely you can help us in our hour of need."
"Greetings, {quest_sibling_term}.  {quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} has great need of your help."
"Alas, it seems as if even {quest_original_alignment_deity} has deserted us."
en.nethack.quest.mon.hasamulet.synopsis: [Take the Amulet to the Astral Plane and deliver it to {quest_original_alignment_deity}.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.hasamulet.text:
"You have prevailed, {quest_player_name}!  {quest_original_alignment_deity} is surely with you.  Now,
you must take the Amulet, and sacrifice it on {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_s} altar on
the Astral Plane.  I suspect that I shall never see you again in this
life, but I hope to at {quest_original_alignment_deity_modifier_s} feet."
en.nethack.quest.mon.killed_nemesis.text:
{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} gasps:

    "You have only defeated this mortal body.  Know this: my spirit
    is strong.  I shall return and reclaim what is mine!"

With that, {quest_quest_nemesis} expires.
en.nethack.quest.mon.leader_first.synopsis: [{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} checks whether you are ready for the great challenge.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.leader_first.text:
"Ah, {quest_player_name}, my {quest_child_term}.  You have returned to us at last.
A great blow has befallen our order; perhaps you can help us.
First, however, I must determine if you are prepared for this
great challenge."
en.nethack.quest.mon.leader_last.synopsis: [You are a heretic and have failed utterly.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.leader_last.text:
"You are a heretic, {quest_player_name}!  How can you, {quest_current_rank_modifier_a}, deviate so from the
teachings of {quest_original_alignment_deity}?  Begone from this temple.  You are no longer
{quest_sibling_term_modifier_a} to this order.  We will pray to {quest_original_alignment_deity} for other assistance,
as you have failed us utterly."
en.nethack.quest.mon.leader_next.text: "Again, my {quest_child_term}, you stand before me.  Are you ready now to help us?"
en.nethack.quest.mon.leader_other.text: "Once more, {quest_player_name}, you stand within the sanctum.  Are you ready now?"
en.nethack.quest.mon.locate_first.text:
You remember the descriptions of {quest_intermediate_destination}, given
to you by {quest_quest_leader}.  It is ahead that you will find
{quest_quest_nemesis}'s trail.
en.nethack.quest.mon.nemesis_first.synopsis: [You are no {quest_quest_guardian}.  You shall never regain {quest_quest_artifact}.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.nemesis_first.text:
"Ah, so {quest_quest_leader} has sent another {quest_quest_guardian} to retrieve
{quest_quest_artifact}.

"No, I see you are no {quest_quest_guardian}.  Perhaps I shall have some fun today
after all.  Prepare to die, {quest_current_rank}!  You shall never regain
{quest_quest_artifact}."
en.nethack.quest.mon.nemesis_other.text: "Die now, {quest_current_rank}.  {quest_original_alignment_deity} has no power here to aid you."
en.nethack.quest.mon.nemesis_wantsit.text: "You shall die, {quest_current_rank}, and I will have {quest_quest_artifact} back."
en.nethack.quest.mon.offeredit.synopsis: [Keep {quest_quest_artifact}.  {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_H} will help you recover the Amulet of Yendor.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.offeredit.text:
"You have returned, {quest_player_name}.  And with {quest_quest_artifact}, I see.
Congratulations.

"I have been in meditation, and have received direction from
a minion of {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  {quest_original_alignment_deity} commands that you retain
{quest_quest_artifact}.  With {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_i}, you must recover the Amulet
of Yendor.

"Go forth, and let {quest_original_alignment_deity} guide your steps."
en.nethack.quest.mon.offeredit2.synopsis: [Keep {quest_quest_artifact} and return to {quest_dungeon_name} to search for the Amulet.]
en.nethack.quest.mon.offeredit2.text:
{quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} studies {quest_quest_artifact} for a moment,
then returns his gaze to you.

"{quest_quest_artifact_modifier_C} must remain with you.  Use {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_i}
as you resume your search for the Amulet.
{quest_dungeon_name} await your return through the magic portal
that brought you here."
en.nethack.quest.mon.othertime.text:
Again you face {quest_quest_home}.  Your intuition hints that this
may be the final time you come here.
en.nethack.quest.mon.posthanks.text: "Welcome back, {quest_player_name}.  How is your quest for the Amulet going?"
en.nethack.quest.pri.assignquest.synopsis: [{quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_C} invaded {quest_quest_home} and captured {quest_quest_artifact}.  Defeat {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_i} and retrieve {quest_quest_artifact_modifier_h}.]
en.nethack.quest.pri.assignquest.text:
"Yes, {quest_player_name}.  You are truly ready now.  Attend to me and I shall
tell you of what has transpired:

"At one of the Great Festivals a short time ago, {quest_quest_nemesis} and a legion
of undead invaded {quest_quest_home}.  Many {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P} were killed, including
the one carrying {quest_quest_artifact}.

"As a final act of vengefulness, {quest_quest_nemesis} desecrated the altar here.
Without it, we could not mount a counter-attack.  Now, there are
barely enough {quest_quest_guardian_modifier_P} left to keep the undead at bay.

"We need you to find {quest_intermediate_destination}, then, from there, travel
to {quest_quest_nemesis_modifier_s} lair.  If you can manage to defeat {quest_quest_nemesis} and return
{quest_quest_artifact} here, we can then drive off the legions of
undead that befoul the land.

"Go with {quest_original_alignment_deity} as your guide, {quest_player_name}."
en.nethack.quest.pri.badalign.synopsis: [You have deviated from the path.  Return when you have purified yourself.]
en.nethack.quest.pri.badalign.text:
"This is terrible, {quest_player_name}.  You have deviated from the true path!
You know that {quest_original_alignment_deity} requires the most strident devotion of this
order.  The {quest_sibling_term}hood must stand for utmost piety.

"Go from here, atone for your sins against {quest_original_alignment_deity}.  Return only when
you have purified yourself."
en.nethack.quest.pri.badlevel.synopsis: [{quest_current_rank_modifier_A} cannot withstand {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Come back when you are {quest_minimum_quest_rank_modifier_a}.]
en.nethack.quest.pri.badlevel.text:
"Alas, {quest_player_name}, it is not yet to be.  A mere {quest_current_rank} could never
withstand the might of {quest_quest_nemesis}.  Go forth, again into the world, and return
when you have attained the post of {quest_minimum_quest_rank}."
en.nethack.quest.pri.discourage.item_1: "Submit to my will, {quest_role_name}, and I shall spare you."
en.nethack.quest.pri.discourage.item_10: "With {quest_quest_artifact}, nothing can stand in my way."
en.nethack.quest.pri.discourage.item_2: "Your puny powers are no match for me, {quest_role_name}."
en.nethack.quest.pri.discourage.item_3: "I shall have you turned into a zombie for my pleasure!"
en.nethack.quest.pri.discourage.item_5: "I shall feast upon your soul for many days, {quest_role_name}."
en.nethack.quest.pri.discourage.item_6: "Your death will be slow and painful.  That I promise!"
en.nethack.quest.pri.discourage.item_7: "You cannot defeat {quest_quest_nemesis}, you fool.  I shall kill you now."
en.nethack.quest.pri.discourage.item_8: "Your precious {quest_quest_leader_modifier_t} will be my next victim."
en.nethack.quest.pri.discourage.item_9: "I feel your powers failing you, {quest_current_rank}.  You shall die now."
en.nethack.quest.pri.encourage.item_1: "You can prevail, if you rely on {quest_original_alignment_deity}."
en.nethack.quest.pri.encourage.item_10: "Wear {quest_quest_artifact}.  It will assist you against the undead."
en.nethack.quest.pri.encourage.item_2: "Remember that {quest_quest_nemesis} has great magic at his command."
en.nethack.quest.pri.encourage.item_4: "Beware, {quest_intermediate_destination} is surrounded by a great graveyard."
en.nethack.quest.pri.encourage.item_5: "You may be able to affect {quest_quest_nemesis} with magical cold."
en.nethack.quest.pri.encourage.item_6: "Acquire and wear {quest_quest_artifact} if you can.  It will aid you against {quest_quest_nemesis}."
en.nethack.quest.pri.encourage.item_7: "Call upon {quest_original_alignment_deity} when your need is greatest.  You will be answered."
en.nethack.quest.pri.encourage.item_8: "The undead legions are weakest during the daylight hours."
en.nethack.quest.pri.encourage.item_9: "Do not lose faith, {quest_player_name}.  If you do so, {quest_quest_nemesis} will grow stronger."
en.nethack.quest.pri.firsttime.synopsis: [You are at {quest_quest_home}; the doors are closed.  {quest_quest_leader_modifier_C} needs your help!]
en.nethack.quest.pri.firsttime.text:
You find yourself standing in sight of {quest_quest_home}.  Something
is obviously wrong here.  The doors to {quest_quest_home}, which usually
stand open, are closed.  Strange human shapes shamble around
outside.

You realize that {quest_quest_leader} needs your assistance!
en.nethack.quest.pri.goal_first.synopsis: [The stench of brimstone surrounds you, the shrieks and moans are endless.]
en.nethack.quest.pri.goal_first.text:
The stench of brimstone is all about you, and the shrieks and moans
of tortured souls assault your psyche.

Ahead, there is a small clearing amidst the bubbling pits of lava...
